metadata.description: Claude Meta Ads God Mode plus optional native installs of its bundled companion plugins (pinned, vetted copies shipped in this repo). The God Mode write gate applies to every ad-platform write.

plugins.name: ads
plugins.description: Claude Meta Ads God Mode - Meta Ads first, Google Ads built in, paused-first and approval-gated. Includes an on-demand router to 137 bundled community skills (nothing extra preloaded).

plugins.name: agrici-ads
plugins.description: Bundled companion (third-party, MIT, AgriciDaniel/claude-ads@fc3908e): 12-platform paid-media audits, plans, creative workflows and specialist audit agents. Optional native install - God Mode already routes to these skills on demand without installing them.

plugins.name: marketing-skills
plugins.description: Bundled companion (third-party, MIT, coreyhaines31/marketingskills@e85f3cb): 40+ marketing skills: paid ads, ad creative, attribution, conversion tracking, CRO, copywriting, A/B testing, launch. Optional native install - God Mode already routes to these skills on demand without installing them.

plugins.name: meta-ads-genius
plugins.description: Bundled companion (third-party, MIT, aaronpdoherty/meta-ads-genius@3fcacc3): Meta analysis, opportunity spotting, optimization and campaign-management playbooks plus a read-only auditor agent. Optional native install - God Mode already routes to these skills on demand without installing them.

plugins.name: adplane
plugins.description: Optional (third-party hosted connector): Google, Meta, Microsoft, TikTok via Adplane's MCP. Sends account data to Adplane; requires an Adplane account. Not installed automatically.
